status: Reconciled against pristine HEAD and final rich net10.0 Roslyn inventories

provenance.baselinePreparation: git archive of exact HEAD expanded into a new isolated artifacts directory; no working-tree source copied into baseline.
limits: Inventory covers externally visible public declarations at net10.0. Other-target availability is documented by the capability matrix and separately verified all-target builds, not separately extracted inventories.

Token hashes exclude trivia but include declaration and implementation; changes establish source changes, not proof that externally observable behavior changed. Type-body hashes are not used to duplicate changed-member reports.

An unchanged declaration can inherit behavior changes through dependencies. This map records direct declaration/implementation changes; behavioral acceptance remains established by tests and the implementation report.

exceptions.reason: Nested Core owner supplies type; flattened string-input clauses use terminal parsed-type qualifier.
Attribute input-representation discrimination follows DataAnnotations naming; String is not a raw-result projection.
XSD validity differs from well-formedness; dedicated XML namespace isolates framework type-name collisions.
Framework collision-safe vocabulary; actual declaring types reconciled against final inventory.
Domain concepts retain semantic nouns rather than redundant parsed-type suffixes.
Affirmative containment predicates use Contains vocabulary.

supplementalChanges.scope: All pass-through overloads; exact baseline removals are included in baselineToFinal.removed.
Raw-result clause twins and corresponding adapters only; do not remove representation-discriminating attributes.
supplementalChanges.contract: Must.Value preserves original input; Must.Result is parsed/normalized; Guard returns successful Result.
Value types use nonnullable out T/default on failure. Nullable reference outputs use NotNullWhen(true) only when true guarantees nonnull. Safe empty reference-output contracts retained.

supplementalChanges.scope: Collection membership/subset and nonnull element validation
supplementalChanges.contract: Explicit comparer controls equality independently of runtime collection shape. Nullable value elements supported. Successful nonnull-item projection preserves original Must.Value and enumerates once.

supplementalChanges.reason: Same Utility/Rules predicate vocabulary as IsHex and IsBase64; applied after recorded rename proposal.
